title: On the measure of spectra for discrete Schrödinger operators on periodic graphs
summary: We consider discrete Schrödinger operators $H_{μQ}=Δ+μQ$ with real periodic potentials $Q$ on periodic graphs, where $Δ$ is the adjacency operator and $μ\in\mathbb R$ is a coupling constant. The spectra of the operators consist of a finite number of closed intervals (bands). In the large coupling regime, we obtain an asymptotic upper bound for the measure of the spectrum of $H_{μQ}$ which depends essentially on a "degeneracy degree" of the potential $Q$.
